title: Eighth Session
author: Neal A. Maxwell
source_file: epub/!Ready/Deposition of a Disciple - Neal A Maxwell.epub
note: 1976 Deseret Book. Maxwell's first major book. Structured as 11 'sessions' — devotional meditations in dialogic/epistolary form using the juridical metaphor of a 'deposition' for the disciple's testimony. Written as Assistant to the Twelve (called July 1974).
